arguments.sql:
WITH japanese_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid, f.name AS japanese_name, c.type AS english_type, c.watermark
    FROM main.cards AS c
    JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE f.language = 'Japanese'
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT japanese_name, english_type
    FROM japanese_printings
    WHERE watermark = 'boros'
),
matching AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM japanese_printings AS p
    JOIN eligible AS e
      ON p.japanese_name IS e.japanese_name AND p.english_type IS e.english_type
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible) AS eligible_cards,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible WHERE japanese_name IS NULL OR english_type IS NULL) AS missing_identity,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching WHERE watermark = 'boros') AS boros_printings,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching WHERE watermark IS NOT 'boros') AS other_printings,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matching AS m JOIN main.rulings AS r ON r.uuid = m.uuid
     WHERE m.watermark IS NOT 'boros') AS other_printing_rulings,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.cards AS c JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
     WHERE c.watermark = 'boros' AND f.language = 'Japanese') AS boros_japanese_rows

arguments.sql:
WITH japanese_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.uuid,
        f.name AS japanese_name,
        c.type AS english_type,
        c.watermark
    FROM main.cards AS c
    JOIN main.foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE f.language = 'Japanese'
)
SELECT
    p.japanese_name,
    p.english_type,
    COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
FROM japanese_printings AS p
LEFT JOIN main.rulings AS r ON r.uuid = p.uuid
GROUP BY p.japanese_name, p.english_type
HAVING MAX(p.watermark = 'boros') = 1
ORDER BY p.japanese_name, p.english_type
LIMIT -1
